question: What is our total monthly recurring revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(mrr_usd) FROM subscriptions

question: How many active employees do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE employment_status = 'active'

question: What is our annual recurring revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(arr_usd) FROM subscriptions

question: Show me our current headcount
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees

question: What is the average CSAT score?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(csat_score) FROM support_tickets

question: How many open opportunities are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opportunities WHERE stage = 'open'

question: What is our total pipeline value?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM opportunities WHERE closed_at IS NULL

question: How many marketing qualified leads did we get?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'MQL'

question: What is our total ARR by customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name, SUM(s.arr_usd) FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company_name

question: Which customers have the highest ARR?
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name, s.arr_usd FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY s.arr_usd DESC

question: What is the average deal size by opportunity stage?
gold_sql: SELECT stage, AVG(amount) FROM opportunities GROUP BY stage

question: Show employee headcount by department
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.employee_id) FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.name

question: Which department has the largest annual budget?
gold_sql: SELECT name, budget_annual_usd FROM departments ORDER BY budget_annual_usd DESC

question: What is our average employee satisfaction score?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(numeric_score) FROM performance_reviews

question: How many support tickets are still unresolved?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NULL

question: What is our lead conversion rate?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL

question: Show me revenue per employee by team
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(e.employee_id) FROM employees e JOIN teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.name

question: Which sales rep owns the most opportunities?
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.opportunity_id) FROM opportunities o JOIN employees e ON o.owner_employee_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY COUNT(o.opportunity_id) DESC

question: What is the total amount invoiced per customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name, SUM(i.total_usd) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company_name

question: How much have we spent on campaigns this year?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(spend_usd) FROM campaigns

question: SELECT customer_id, total_usd FROM invoices WHERE status = 'unpaid'
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, total_usd FROM invoices WHERE status = 'unpaid'

question: Show invoices joined to customers with company_name
gold_sql: SELECT i.invoice_id, c.company_name FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id

question: List employees with their department_id and team_id
gold_sql: SELECT employee_id, department_id, team_id FROM employees

question: Count support_tickets grouped by priority
gold_sql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets GROUP BY priority

question: Show opportunities with owner_employee_id and stage
gold_sql: SELECT opportunity_id, owner_employee_id, stage FROM opportunities

question: List subscriptions with mrr_usd and arr_usd
gold_sql: SELECT subscription_id, mrr_usd, arr_usd FROM subscriptions

question: Show products joined to product_categories
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, pc.name FROM products p JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id

question: List orders with their order_items and products
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, oi.quantity, p.name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

question: Show payments joined to invoices and customers
gold_sql: SELECT p.amount, i.invoice_id, c.company_name FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN customers c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id

question: List employees with job_titles and departments
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, jt.title, d.name FROM employees e JOIN job_titles jt ON e.job_title_id = jt.job_title_id JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id

question: Show leads converted into customers with their campaigns
gold_sql: SELECT l.lead_id, c.company_name, camp.name FROM leads l JOIN customers c ON l.converted_customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN campaigns camp ON l.campaign_id = camp.campaign_id

question: Which teams belong to which department?
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, d.name FROM teams t JOIN departments d ON t.department_id = d.department_id

question: Show ticket_comments for each support_ticket
gold_sql: SELECT tc.body, st.category FROM ticket_comments tc JOIN support_tickets st ON tc.ticket_id = st.ticket_id

question: Which employees report to which manager?
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, m.first_name FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id

question: Show projects and the department that owns them
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, d.name FROM projects p JOIN departments d ON p.department_id = d.department_id

question: how much money are we making each month from subscriptions
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(mrr_usd) FROM subscriptions

question: who are our best performing sales people
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.opportunity_id) FROM opportunities o JOIN employees e ON o.owner_employee_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY COUNT(o.opportunity_id) DESC

question: are customers happy with our support
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(csat_score) FROM support_tickets

question: how many people work in each office
gold_sql: SELECT o.city, COUNT(e.employee_id) FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.office_id = o.office_id GROUP BY o.city

question: which products bring in the most money
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC

question: do we have any overdue invoices
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND paid_at IS NULL

question: what is the gender pay gap across job levels
gold_sql: SELECT jt.level, AVG(c.base_salary_usd) FROM compensation c JOIN employees e ON c.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN job_titles jt ON e.job_title_id = jt.job_title_id GROUP BY jt.level

question: which marketing channel brings the most leads
gold_sql: SELECT camp.channel, COUNT(l.lead_id) FROM leads l JOIN campaigns camp ON l.campaign_id = camp.campaign_id GROUP BY camp.channel ORDER BY COUNT(l.lead_id) DESC

question: how long does it take us to resolve tickets
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(resolved_at - created_at) FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL

question: are we growing our customer base
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE created_at > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months'
